issues.extracted: receipts/disbursements entered per fund column (e.g. 'Property (General Fund)' 351,410, 'Property (Street Fund)' 2,467, 'Property (Community Development Agency Fund)' 2,000)
issues.on_page: Total Governmental Funds column (p6): Property 355,877, Intergovernmental 628,082, Charges for services 105,920, etc.
issues.issue: The rules call for the governmental funds statement's Total Governmental Funds column. Instead, the lines are entered per fund, and the General Fund intergovernmental and charges lines are replaced by department-schedule lines (p24). Every amount is printed and all lines tie to the totals (2,816,066 / 3,511,494), but the column choice departs from the rules.

A loan principal repayment is categorized as other taxes, following config/category_decisions.csv row 'loan repayment sales tax fund'. The same label is 'other' / Loan Collections in detail[68] and for the Economic Development and CDA funds (receipts[24], [36]). This may be a slip in the CSV decision.

issues.on_page: Rental and fees 63,539 (Ambulance 50,248, Cemetery 6,095, Admin 3,125, Zoning 2,505, Library 1,566)
issues.issue: Ambulance fees are 79% of the line. Under the user's 2026-10-28 rule the dominant category would be Ambulance Fees. The matching detail lines (Ambulance, Cemetery, Admin rental) are also still in charges for services/fees instead of Ambulance Fees / Cemetery Fees / Rentals.

These are pool admissions and concessions. The user's 2026-10-28 rule puts pool/recreation fees in category Recreation Fees. The same applies to receipts[32] (Cemetery Perpetual Care charges 1,050), which would be Cemetery Fees.

issues.on_page: Sales: Residential 2,204,375 (also Commercial, Municipal, Industrial, Sewer use fees, Customer charges)
issues.issue: These are utility fund sales and charges. The user's 2026-10-28 rule makes them category Utility Charges (receipts[41]-[46]).

Business-type spending here is listed by cost type, and the other cost-type lines carry a cost-type category with function utilities. This vehicle/transportation cost line was left as the function 'utilities' and has no function field.

issues.on_page: Current portion of interfund notes payable 17,410 (also liabilities[9] Noncurrent portion 188,579)
issues.issue: Internal Balances is an asset category, not on the liability category list. Other liabilities may be the intended category.

issues.on_page: Governmental funds statements are 'Modified Cash Basis'; business-type is accrual
issues.issue: Governmental figures are modified cash basis but the report is marked GAAP, so fund-balance fields are used and beginning_cash is null. This is defensible because the statement rolls fund balances forward, but it is an assumption.
